_comment: MODEL ROUTING POLICY — no model IDs are hardcoded in the routing path.
At runtime jobhunter.llm.catalog queries OpenRouter for the models that are
CURRENTLY free (price 0 in + 0 out), keeps only real text->text chat models, and
ranks them per task using capability heuristics (family prior, parameter count,
context window, JSON/structured-output support, reasoning support, output length,
advertised rate limits). Use `pinned_models` only if you want to force a specific
model to the front of a chain.
Free reasoning models will spend an entire completion budget on internal
monologue and never reach the JSON. `effort` caps the thinking, `exclude` keeps
it out of the response body, and token_multiplier gives reasoning models extra
headroom so thinking can never starve the answer. Set a task to false to turn
reasoning off completely for models that allow it.
Free OpenRouter keys are capped at ~50 free-model requests/day and ~20/minute.
Real limits are auto-detected via GET /api/v1/key and multiplied by safety_margin.
reserve_per_task holds calls back so resume generation is never starved by parsing.
